environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door Premium with Rules Engine v2. A response header override rule (priority 1, route: /*) appends a header transformation action. The transformation adds 'Content-Security-Policy' with value derived from a Front Door Policy variable concatenation: base directive 'default-src \'self\'' merged with script-src restriction. The effective header emitted is assembled from two chained rule actions: Action 1 sets 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'self\'', Action 2 appends '; object-src \'none\'; base-uri \'self\''. Note: the Rules Engine header append uses 'Overwrite' semantics so application-level headers cannot override it. The Front Door WAF policy (Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet_2.1) is in Detection mode only and does NOT block requests.

config.front_door: Azure Front Door Premium with Rules Engine v2
config.note: CSP header is enforced at CDN edge layer via header transformation, not application middleware
